title: Scope.
officialText:
The provisions of this chapter shall govern the design and installation of piping and storage systems for non-
flammable medical gas systems and nonmedical oxygen systems. All maintenance and operations of such systems shall be in
accordance with the New York City Fire Code.
SECTION PC 1202
MEDICAL GASES
